From: office@cedarschool.example
Subject: Cedar School October family bulletin

Dear families, thank you for supporting our library fundraiser. Our reading program has reached 500 books! All dates below are in 2026; timed activities use PDT.

UPCOMING SCHOOL DATES
October 5, 08:15–08:45 — Welcome assembly — Cedar School Gym. Families may attend; enter through the east doors.
October 7, 18:00–19:30 — Family science night — Cedar School Hall. Bring a recycled cardboard box for the building activity.
October 9 (all day) — Teacher workday. School is closed to students.
October 12–14 (all days, inclusive) — Autumn break. No classes on these three days.

CLUBS AND VOLUNTEERS
October 15, 15:15–16:15 — Garden club — School Garden. Bring gloves and a water bottle.
October 21, 17:00–18:00 — PTA budget meeting — Library. Read the budget at https://cedarschool.example/budget before attending.

OTHER NEWS
Our cafeteria now offers more vegetarian meals. Volunteer training dates will be announced later; there is no scheduled session yet. The lost-and-found cupboard is overflowing. Please label jackets. This bulletin lists each event once; section headings and general reminders are not additional events.

Cedar School Office | https://cedarschool.example
